title: File Guard
summary: Checks files before upload, including their first bytes, so renamed, empty, duplicate or oversized files are caught before they start uploading.
description: Checks size, type, count, empty files and duplicates, and reads each file's first bytes to catch a renamed extension, with a one-tap rename fix.
catches: Files over maxSize, or more than maxFiles
A file whose content doesn't match its extension (renamed)
limits: Magic-byte detection covers common formats only
Runs in the browser and is easy to bypass; it is not a malware scan
a11y: The pick button is described by the hint; the native input is hidden from the tab order
Selected files are a labelled list; remove buttons name the file
server: Re-validate size, type and content on the server and scan uploads; never trust the client's checks.
